profile.headline: Software Engineer at Richmond National Insurance

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Perform programming assignments and tasks
• Debug, troubleshoot, and isolate software issues
• Work from requirement specifications to develop and maintain code
• Develop test plans and test requirements and design from requirement specifications

company.name: Virginia Farm Bureau Family of Companies

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked in collaboration with other team members to migrate the Think of Us Life Coaching Platform from Knockout JS to Angular 6
•	Designed application features as well as relational SQL database architecture 
•	Created and documented APIs to support data retrieval, input, and updating
•	Built responsive, cross-browser front ends which allow the Think of Us Platform to run on Internet Explorer, Chrome, Safari, and other browsers, enabling maximum flexibility for the user  
•	Unit tested, refactored code, and debugged front end and back end components which make up the Think of Us Platform

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
•	Developed graphics for a wide array of customer proposals, adding depth and clarity to the overall proposal message
•	Retouched photographs in support of product catalog development using Photoshop
•	Created marketing and branding materials used in many corporate communications and presentation materials
•	Worked as a member of a large proposal team to meet a wide array of graphics task including: Proposal graphics, photo retouching/manipulation, marketing and branding material, text layout, typography, and research support

positions.title: Content Producer
positions.description:
•	Filmed, and edited video and audio content for the Think of Us life coaching platform
•	Created Interactive video experiences using Adventur software
•	Responsible for setting up video shoots and coordinating input and content from multiple team members

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description:
•	Performed digital document organization, editing, and content creation for the studio art catalog
•	Developed sewing and textile art work under the direction of the principal studio artist
